resources.string: Automatic analysis and learning run while charging or above your selected battery level. The default is 75%; choose 50–95%. Heat, power saver, memory and device load can still pause work.
Missing inputs are left out. Text alone cannot produce a genre suggestion. Copies of the same recording share one vote; new models are checked on recordings excluded from their training.
More distinct, labelled recordings are needed to evaluate genre accuracy.
Kept the previous genre model because the candidate performed worse.
Name audio files using their embedded title and artist tags.

Uses the actual embedded title tag. Keeps the folder, audio extension and existing links. Files without a title, files playing now and inaccessible files are skipped. Existing files are never overwritten.
%1$d files need permission or another attempt. Preview to review them.
No filenames to change. Files already organized, playing, unavailable or missing title tags are skipped.
Review up to 500 changes per preview. After applying, preview again for more files.
Files without permission were left unchanged. You can try again later.
Could not complete the changes. Check file access and preview again.
